mapper.select: SELECT store_id FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET order_stage='CANCELED',canceled_at=#{canceledAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, cancel_reason='ADMIN_ABNORMAL_CLOSE',refund_order_id=#{refundId},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND version=#{version} AND order_stage IN ('PENDING_CONFIRM','PENDING_SERVICE') AND payment_status='PAID' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND canceled_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND current_refund_application_id IS NULL AND current_aftersale_id IS NULL AND refunded_amount=0
mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id,store_id,action_type,reason_code,reason,order_version_before,refund_order_id, acted_by_operator_id,acted_at,authz_version,request_id,trace_id FROM order_admin_action WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND action_type='ABNORMAL_CLOSE'
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET refunded_amount=#{amount},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND refund_order_id=#{refundId} AND order_stage='CANCELED' AND cancel_reason='ADMIN_ABNORMAL_CLOSE' AND refunded_amount=0
